actionGrants._comment: swift-institute/.github#266 (control-plane surface reachability follow-up, 2026-08-04): swift-institute/Issues carries a root Package.swift (its per-issue reproducers are packages), so it is NOT excluded from the surfaces sweep the way a manifest-less control-plane repo (e.g. this .github repo itself) is, and with no grant naming it here it fell back to the 'package' repositoryClass default and its bespoke ci.yml (an enumerate-issues job with its own steps, feeding a per-issue matrix job that calls the universal reusable) failed REPO-ACTIONS-003 (schedule trigger not granted under the package-class grant above), -004 (direct actions/checkout + this exact swift-ci.yml reference not in the package-class uses list), and -005 (thin-caller shape forbids non-reusable steps). This grant both names the repositoryClass override (control-plane, matching #266's ruleset-side control-plane classification for the same repo and the same reproducer-CI rationale) and the 'bespoke' kind that exempts this shape from the thin-caller structural constraint while still enforcing explicit trigger/uses allowlists below.

swift-institute/.github#276 predicate-18 finding (2026-08-04), decided together with the same-day ruleset-class-overrides.json addition for this repo: REPO-ACTIONS-001 denied deploy-docs.yml under the package-class default (no grant named this path). Reclassifying the repository as control-plane (Tools/repository-policy/Policy/ruleset-class-overrides.json, same rationale as swift-institute/Issues) makes an exact typed 'bespoke' actionGrant the correct disposition here too, in place of a blanket surface exemption: it still enforces exact trigger/uses allowlists (REPO-ACTIONS-003/004) while exempting the non-reusable-workflow-call shape (steps + runs-on, no workflow_call) from the thin-caller structural constraint (REPO-ACTIONS-002/005), the same mechanism swift-institute/Issues' ci.yml grant above uses. deploy-docs.yml is a standalone GitHub Pages deployment (DocC build + actions/deploy-pages) and cannot become a reusable-workflow caller: documentation *deployment* is explicitly out of scope for the CI/CD refactor programme (#276), which only moves common DocC build/validation evidence into the universal chain.
